g.title: CONTEXT
g.text: Read established context and acquire leases

g.title: FAIL
g.text: Throw; do not claim successful drain
Release any acquired leases in finally

g.title: RECOVER
g.text: Complete retained Prepared or NeedsRecovery operations

g.title: BUDGET
g.text: request, pass and elapsed budgets remain?

g.title: ADD
g.text: Add Considered, Applied and Rejected totals

g.title: STATUS->DONE
g.text: No recovery and no pending requests

g.title: RETURN
g.text: head, elapsed time and stop observation
